main_staff.abstract:
We present globally inverted pressure–temperature (P–T) phase diagrams up to 5,000
GPa for four fundamental planetary materials, Fe, MgO, SiO2, and MgSiO3, derived
from logistic regression and supervised learning, together with an experimental phase
equilibria database. These new P–T phase diagrams provide a solution to long-standing
disputes about their melting curves.
Their implications extend to the melting and
freezing of rocky materials in the interior of giant planets and super-Earth exoplanets,
contributing to the refinement of their internal structure models.
Keywords: Planetary structure (1256) — Planetary mineralogy (2304) — Exoplanets
